summary_1line: Krishna contrasts divine and demonic qualities, warns against lust, anger, and greed, and explains how faith, food, sacrifice, and discipline reflect the three gunas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna stands beside Arjuna on the chariot as he describes two paths, while visions of serene divine figures and chaotic demonic beings appear in the sky.
A proud warrior surrounded by piles of gold boasts of his power while shadowy nooses labeled desire, anger, and greed coil around him.
Three symbolic offerings on an altar—pure nourishing food, fiery pungent dishes, and rotten refuse—represent the three qualities of goodness, passion, and darkness.
